shortDescription: Waits for a condition before continuing

options.name: active_connection_states
options.description: The list of TCP connection states which are counted as active connections.

options.name: connect_timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for a connection to happen before closing and retrying.

options.name: delay
options.description: Number of seconds to wait before starting to poll.

options.name: exclude_hosts
options.description: List of hosts or IPs to ignore when looking for active TCP connections for V(drained) state.

options.name: host
options.description: A resolvable hostname or IP address to wait for.

options.name: msg
options.description: This overrides the normal error message from a failure to meet the required conditions.

options.name: path
options.description: Path to a file on the filesystem that must exist before continuing. O(path) and O(port) are mutually exclusive parameters.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number to poll. O(path) and O(port) are mutually exclusive parameters.

options.name: search_regex
options.description: Can be used to match a string in either a file or a socket connection. Defaults to a multiline regex.

options.name: sleep
options.description: Number of seconds to sleep between checks. Before Ansible 2.3 this was hardcoded to 1 second.

options.name: state
options.description: Either V(present), V(started), or V(stopped), V(absent), or V(drained). When checking a port V(started) will ensure the port is open, V(stopped) will check that it is closed, V(drained) will check for active connections. When checking for a file or a search string V(present) or V(started) will ensure that the file or string is present before continuing, V(absent) will check that file is absent or removed.

options.name: timeout
options.description: Maximum number of seconds to wait for, when used with another condition it will force an error. When used without other conditions it is equivalent of just sleeping.
